name: hcapp_addDownDown
description: Records a DownDown charge against one or more people at a run. Anyone authenticated may submit, checked in or not. Targets are registered hashers (@hasherIds, pipe-delimited UUIDs), people not in the app (@externalNames, a JSON array of names, stored on HC.DownDowns.ExternalNames), or a mix — at least one valid target is required, together with @kennelId, @eventId and a non-blank @chargeText (else 1234 / errorType 2). Where COALESCE(Event.CanEditRunAttendence, Kennel.CanEditRunAttendence) = 1 the caller is checked in first via HC6.nonApi_ensureTrackAttendance (At Hash / RSVP Yes, run counts recomputed, an admin's removal left alone); otherwise attendance is untouched (1.1.0, James 2026-09-12; 1.0.0 refused anyone below At Hash). Creates one HC.DownDowns row and one HC.DownDownHashers row per valid hasher UUID and returns the new id as rowset 0 { downDownId }. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 55, standard token). No permission gate. Blank test is LEN()-based so an emoji-only charge survives the collation. New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event (run) the charge belongs to. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: hasherIds
parameters.description: Pipe-delimited list of hasher UUID strings to charge; each valid UUID produces one DownDownHashers row, invalid values are silently skipped via TRY_CAST. May be empty or NULL when @externalNames supplies the targets. No default.

parameters.name: chargeText
parameters.description: Description of the charge. Required — NULL, empty or whitespace-only triggers 1234. No default.

parameters.name: songChoice
parameters.description: Optional suggested song name (free text). Stored as NULL if blank.

parameters.name: songId
parameters.description: Optional FK to HC.Song for the suggested song. NULL if not specified.

parameters.name: chargePhotoUrl
parameters.description: Optional blob URL of an attached charge photo. Stored as NULL if blank.

parameters.name: externalNames
parameters.description: Optional JSON array of names for people not in the app, e.g. ["Dizzy Lizzy","Two-Buck Chuck"]. Counted only when ISJSON = 1 and the entry is non-blank; stored verbatim on the DownDowns row when at least one such name exists, otherwise NULL. Default NULL.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On any failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } followed by the error detail at index 1. ValidateAppAuth 1155 invalid token (errorType 1) / 1355 device not registered (3) / 1255 signed out (7); 1234 missing parameter or no target (2); 1933 unhandled (5).
Error detail after the ErrorEnvelope on every failure path (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc).

rowsets.name: Success
rowsets.description: On success the ONLY rowset: the new charge's id (no success envelope).

columns.name: downDownId
columns.description: The newly created HC.DownDowns.id (NEWID() inside the SP).

sideEffects: When the run or kennel allows self-set attendance, EXEC HC6.nonApi_ensureTrackAttendance (own transaction, BEFORE the charge transaction, result row swallowed): inserts or raises the caller's HC.HasherEventMap row to AttendenceState 20 / RsvpState 3 and recomputes their run counts; a row an admin removed is left alone.
INSERT HC.DownDowns (id, EventId, KennelId, ChargeText, SongChoice, SongId, IsDone = 0, CreatedByUserId, ChargePhotoUrl, ExternalNames) — inside a transaction.
INSERT HC.DownDownHashers (DownDownId, HasherId) per valid UUID in @hasherIds — same transaction.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1234 and in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK).

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: Self check-in runs outside TRY/CATCH and in its own transaction
codeSmells.detail: Lines 129-139: the EXEC HC6.nonApi_ensureTrackAttendance happens before BEGIN TRY. An error inside it is an unlogged raw 500 for this call, and because it commits on its own, a later failure of the charge INSERT (1933) leaves the caller checked in with no charge recorded.

codeSmells.issue: IsDone and IsCancelled columns are BIT in the table, not SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: HC.DownDowns.IsDone and IsCancelled are declared as BIT NOT NULL. The project standard is SMALLINT. The SP inserts 0 (integer literal), which SQL Server implicitly converts to BIT. Dart callers must handle these as JSON booleans (true/false), not integers (1/0), because the .NET shim serialises BIT as JSON boolean.

codeSmells.issue: Silent skip of invalid hasher UUIDs
codeSmells.detail: TRY_CAST in the INSERT ... SELECT silently discards any value in @hasherIds that is not a valid UUID. If the caller passes a malformed UUID no error is returned. This could silently produce fewer DownDownHashers rows than expected.

codeSmells.issue: errorCode 1933 is shared with other SPs' CATCH blocks
codeSmells.detail: Line 169: the unhandled-error code 1933 is also used by hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus and hcapp_cancelDownDown, so the code alone does not identify the SP in HC.ErrorLog (errorProc does).
